name: cody-codex-coordinator
description: Turn one Codex task into a durable repository coordinator with bounded orchestration and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate, route, and recover repository work.
interface.longDescription: Cody establishes one durable repository coordinator that verifies state, routes bounded work, preserves checkpoints, and recovers interrupted operations.
defaultPrompt: Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to take over this repository and report verified status.
Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to plan and coordinate this repository outcome.
Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to recover this interrupted repository task.
